g.text: ActiveHub implemented booking, compensation and delivery collaboration
in-app notice, outbox, idempotency response; commit
same lock order, one payment, last4 only
release quota, return visits, reverse original points
full payment refund once, terminal status/history, notices
claim committed outbox row, persistent retry state
Q-01 reversal clamps at zero; Q-02 uses the session month in Europe/Kyiv.
Q-03 cutoff is inclusive; Q-04 corporate eligibility lasts until calendar expiry.
External SMTP exactly-once delivery is not claimed.
